description: This file defines a mock implementation of an API client object with methods for HTTP GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations. It serves as a placeholder for actual fetch or axios logic, used during development or testing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronous method that simulates an HTTP GET request, returning a promise resolving to an object indicating success, the request path, and null data.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Asynchronous method that simulates an HTTP POST request, returning a promise resolving to an object indicating success, the request path, request body, and null data.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Asynchronous method that simulates an HTTP PUT request, returning a promise resolving to an object indicating success, the request path, request body, and null data.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Asynchronous method that simulates an HTTP DELETE request, returning a promise resolving to an object indicating success, the request path, and null data.
